verdict.rationale: Navan exposes a well-documented REST API with OAuth2 client-credentials flow, expense/card/travel endpoints, and an MCP server for AI assistants, which supports API-native and agentic development. However, the evidence never mentions actual official SDKs (e.g., Python, Node.js, Java client libraries) — only raw API/MCP documentation. missing for 10: named official language SDKs/client libraries, code samples in SDK form, versioned SDK release notes.
